summary_en: UACJ Corporation authorized the acquisition of up to 9.2 million shares (5.08% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of 15.0 billion yen through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 11, 2026 to March 31, 2027, with all acquired shares to be cancelled on April 28, 2027, aimed at maximizing enterprise and shareholder value through improved ROE and PBR.
title_en: Notice Regarding Decisions on Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 10, 2026, UACJ Corporation's board of directors approved the acquisition of treasury shares under Article 156 of the Companies Act. The company will acquire up to 9.2 million shares of common stock, representing a maximum of 5.1% of outstanding shares (calculated from 181.1 million shares outstanding as of September 30, 2026), for a maximum total of 15.0 billion yen through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The acquisition period runs from November 11, 2026 through March 31, 2027, excluding December 1–8, 2026 when the company will not purchase shares due to procedures related to implementing an employee stock ownership plan trust. All shares acquired will be cancelled effective April 28, 2027.

The company undertakes this transaction to strengthen shareholder returns and enhance capital efficiency, thereby increasing share value. The action aligns with the Fourth Medium-Term Management Plan's strategic focus on maximizing enterprise and shareholder value through improved return on equity (ROE) and price-to-book ratio (PBR), with shareholder total shareholder return (TSR) improvement as the basic policy.
